svg.title: taeo_flat floor plan
svg.text: Floor plan in metres, north up. Mangwon-dong, Mapo-gu (fictional building, no real address). 18.0 m² interior (6.00 × 3.00 m), plus a 0.90 m service balcony. Ceiling 2.30 m.
6.00 m interior (door wall to window wall)
4F floor ≈ 8.6 m above the lane. No lift: stairs at the
corridor's north end. Floor-to-floor 2.8 m, piloti 3.0 m.
1 Entrance door: grey steel, opens OUT into the corridor;
hinges on the north jamb, lever handle on the south side
2 Shoe area, one tiled step down; shoe cabinet (NW corner);
navy jacket on the hook beside the door
3 Bathroom (wet room): shower, toilet, basin; no window
4 Kitchenette, west to east: washer, sink, 2-ring induction
hob, under-counter fridge; wall cabinets above
5 Clothes rack (black hoodies); backpack on its end hook
6 Desk + stool; wall shelf above with THE FRAMED PHOTO
(parents, Taeo at 14, baby Haru) and the team patch box
7 Desk lamp, warm orange: the only light at night
8 Bed: super-single on storage drawers, grey duvet,
9 Low folding table, pale wood (Taeo's mug)
10 Sliding glass door 1.6 m; grey-blue blackout curtain
11 Balcony: AC outdoor unit, drying rack, 1.0 m rail
12 Summon circle Ø 1.4 m, seam at its centre (ch1, ch24)
13 "1. ASK FIRST." sheet, taped here from ch21
14 Wall AC unit, high on the north wall
P47 establishing from the entry, looking east:
kitchen strip LEFT, bathroom + desk RIGHT, bed by the
window far right, folding table and rack in between
P48 low, from the rack: Taeo on the floor, back to the
P50 over Taeo's shoulder, looking north (window floats
P52 overhead, straight down on the circle
P53 low, from the bed, looking north-west at the seam
P54 low, west of the circle looking east: Nib steps out
toward camera; Taeo pressed on the bed at frame RIGHT
Screen geography (lock): looking IN from the door,
the kitchen strip is LEFT and the bed is RIGHT by the
window. Looking OUT toward the door, the kitchen strip is
RIGHT. Never mirror the room between panels.
• ONE window: the 1.6 m sliding door to the
balcony, east wall. View: the back of the
opposite building and its lit windows; the
rear lane below. Morning sun comes in here.
• Door wall faces the open corridor and the
bus street (west): the scooter Nib sees
• Only other room: the bathroom. "The next
• Lamp on the desk's bed end; Taeo knocks
it over from the bed (ch1 P52).
• Furniture never moves unless a panel moves
it. Orrin (ch24) pins the bed, cracks the
glass door; the balcony rail is bent from
ch24 until the flat is vacated (ch28).
